speaker: Doctor
text: I see you're experiencing significant symptoms like fatigue, night sweats, weight loss, and enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes alongside abdominal pain. To narrow this down, have you noticed any recent fevers, cough, or changes in your bowel habits?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for that detail, which confirms the "B symptoms" often seen in lymphomas. Given your weight loss and night sweats, have you noticed any lumps under your arms or in your neck besides the supraclavicular area? Also, have you experienced any bleeding or easy bruising?

DIAGNOSIS READY: Hodgkin Lymphoma
